verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents a programmable REST API with app registration, auth credentials, and official SDKs (JavaScript, Java, .NET) for voice, SMS, and call-log data, so it can be driven non-interactively from scripts. However, nothing in the evidence describes headless or CI-specific usage. missing for 10: a CLI, documented non-interactive or server-to-server auth for CI pipelines, CI/automation guides, and independent hands-on corroboration.
